shared_elements: rows of short repeated vertical strokes/marks
justification: A is a three-dimensional sculpted head with modelled eyes, nose and mouth and an incised cross-hatched band over the crown, while B is a flat linear composition of two boat forms with upcurved prow and stern carrying rows of vertical crew strokes. The only overlap is the generic presence of repeated short parallel strokes and incised/drawn lines; the subject matter — a human face versus manned vessels — has nothing specific in common.
